scope: Thunderbird starts and connects by itself, and adding an email account works from start to finish.

topics.title: Thunderbird record
details: When you add an account, Voice Companion keeps a record of what it said and heard.
It is named thunderbird-log.txt. Passwords are never written. A helper can read it if something goes wrong.

topics.title: Thunderbird starts and connects
details: Email no longer waits until you press Alt+Tab to Thunderbird and back.
If Thunderbird is slow, its window comes up for a moment. Then it goes away again.
Your keys stay in Voice Companion. This works with Thunderbird hidden or minimized.

topics.title: Adding an email account
details: A sign-in window Thunderbird opens now comes to the front, and you hear what it is.
An account Thunderbird added is always connected to Voice Companion too. You hear its address once.
A work address, such as Microsoft 365, no longer says to type the password in Thunderbird.
